# Code of conduct

This project follows the same values as the site. They are set out in [docs/MISSION.md](../docs/MISSION.md).

## How we work

- **Critique ideas, never people.** No person, company, or group is shamed here.
- **Assume good faith.** People in every sector are mostly doing their best with what they know.
- **Ethics and transparency.** Name your sources, your tools, and any AI help, and say what isn't finished.
- **Positivity with substance.** Kind and rigorous at the same time.
- **Lift while you climb.** Everyone is welcome as they are. Beginner questions count.
- **Protect privacy.** Share as little personal detail as possible, yours or anyone else's.
- **Accept correction gracefully.** Criticism with a reason makes this site better.

## Never allowed

Hate, harassment, doxxing, slurs, or mocking anyone's question.

## If something goes wrong

Email feedback@aiconsumerrights.org. Robert Sweetman reads every message. He may remove a comment, close an issue, or ask someone to step back, and he will say why.
